Uvalde and surrounding communities have been devastated by catastrophic flooding.

Texas has responded with overwhelming force. More than 2,700 personnel and 1,500 vehicles, aircraft, and specialized resources have helped rescue more than 270 Texans, and evacuated many more.

We will not stop until every community gets the help it needs. Our communities have been hit hard, but Texas is strong.

I have been briefed by state emergency management officials on the threat to life due to extreme flooding in Southwest and Central Texas. 

Last year’s tragic 4th of July floods were caused by 20.29 inches of rainfall. Through the weekend, we are expecting 30 inches of total rain.

This is a life threatening flood. It is of utmost importance that affected Texans heed weather warnings and local advisories. 

Turn Around Don’t Drown. Check DriveTexas.org if you must be on the roadways.

posts.text:
Operation Lone Star never stops.

A DPS Trooper stopped a vehicle in Val Verde County and found a 6-year-old boy unrestrained in the back seat, and his mother hidden in the trunk.

The driver, a human smuggler from Laredo, was arrested and faces felony smuggling charges. 

In Texas, we relentlessly hunt down smugglers.

posts.text:
One year ago today, more than 100 lives were cut short in Kerr County and even more across Central Texas due to devastating flash floods. 

Tonight, I joined the Symphony of the Hills and read the names of 119 lost souls. We must never forget them.

The Kerrville community rose from this tragedy the same way our nation has risen from every trial. 

That enduring spirit will ensure that our communities and our great nation will forever prevail.

posts.text:
Kelly led the Comptroller’s office during a pivotal chapter for Texas.

His leadership and experience, from the local school board to the Texas Legislature, helped make possible the launch of the largest school choice program in our nation’s history, expanding educational opportunity for Texas families.

Thank you, Kelly, for your dedicated service to our great state and for helping deliver this historic achievement for generations of Texas students.

Today’s Supreme Court decision is a missed opportunity to restore the original meaning of the 14th Amendment. 

Birthright citizenship has become a powerful magnet for illegal immigration that will forever change our nation if left unaddressed. Automatic citizenship for children born to parents in the United States illegally or only temporarily is an absurdity that was never contemplated by our Constitution nor agreed to by the American people.

posts.text:
Huge win at the Supreme Court for girls' sports.

In Texas, we've been clear: no boys in girls' sports. I signed it into law.

Today fairness prevailed. Female athletes earned their place -- and now it's protected.

This is a win for women, for truth, and for the common sense our nation was founded on.
